decisions.reason: Although not central to the software-defined direction, the firm has already invested and publicly committed to this conferencing service, so management persists and attributes weak results to the industry downturn.
As a central data-centre interconnection product with visible customer adoption, strong sunk costs and public commitment make withdrawal very unlikely.
Its dedicated product page and core role in optical connectivity signal high visibility and investment, so management continues to escalate commitment.
